page: Amazon Web Services c8id.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. It features 128 vCPUs across 64 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, yielding 2.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of 7600 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, and the instance utilizes the Nitro hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores all placing in the top 10% of tested systems. The processor's L3 cache of 480 MB and support for Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 instructions contribute to top-tier results in extended instructions, encryption, and physics tests. Memory bandwidth is also highly efficient, with read-only small and large block transfers scoring in the top 10%. However, a performance tradeoff is visible in single-core metrics; stress-ng single-core performance falls in the average middle 50%, whereas multi-threaded operations like bzip3 decompression reach top-tier status.

The server demonstrates strong capabilities in data-intensive and database operations, with Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput both ranking in the top 10%. For machine learning workloads, LLM inference prompt processing consistently ranks in the top 10% across small, medium, and large models, though text generation speed for small models drops to the middle 50%. Given the high density of dedicated compute resources, DDR5 memory speed, and integrated 7600 GB NVMe SSD storage, this instance offers a specialized hardware profile for workloads requiring high parallel processing capacity and rapid local storage access without the added cost of external storage attachments. Best-fit workloads include multi-threaded software compilation, database operations, ray tracing, and large-scale text and image processing.
description: Amazon Web Services c8id.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server featuring 128 vCPUs, 64 physical cores, and an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory at 7 GHz and 7600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, running on the Nitro hypervisor with 50 Gbps network bandwidth. Benchmark results place this server in the top 10% for multi-core CPU performance, memory read bandwidth, and database operations. It supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX, making it highly effective for parallel processing tasks. While single-core performance and small-model LLM text generation fall into average tiers, its multi-threaded capabilities, software compilation, and Redis SET operations are top-tier. This hardware profile is suited for database hosting, multi-threaded software compilation, and prompt-heavy LLM inference workloads.
